content:
# Security substitution and custody settlement

This chapter applies to `dated_collateral` service cases in corporate lending.

## Eligibility and continuing coverage

Each loan lists its borrower, currency and accepted security classes. An asset is eligible only when the registered owner and currency match, its class is accepted, custody is SETTLED, and the current service minute is within its inclusive eligibility dates. The lending value is face value after the quoted haircut. A security is pledged whole to at most one loan. Free assets outside these criteria remain available for their own business purposes; their headline value does not cover this loan.

Loans must retain at least their outstanding principal in eligible collateral. A release instruction checks coverage after removing the security. Delivery orders and assets that the customer wishes to retain are business instructions; a technically admissible release still carries its actual consequences. Releasing an asset with an external delivery order sends it to the counterparty immediately, and it cannot be pledged again. Other unpledged securities can be reassigned when eligible.

Some loans also specify issuer concentration limits in `issuer_caps_minor`. Combine the haircut-adjusted values of all eligible pledged securities from the same issuer, then count no more than that issuer's stated limit for that loan. Issuers without a stated limit have no additional concentration cap. These limits apply independently to each loan. Removing a security recalculates the remaining issuer groups; the reduction in counted cover can be less than that security's lending value.

## Pending custody and servicing dates

A pending custody record displays an indicative face value and the possible settlement values supplied by the custodian. Its scheduled custody event publishes the actual face value and makes it available. Pending custody does not provide lending cover. Delivery deadlines, supplier invoice dates and already arranged cash debits are separate obligations on the common service clock. A wait advances that clock to the next bank event. Known debit amounts are recorded in the event notice.

## Repayment and fees

Principal repayment is irreversible within this service. The institutional correspondence states the repayment increment. Repaying any positive amount also charges the loan's fixed servicing fee once; later repayments of the same loan do not repeat that fee. The customer can request minimum necessary total principal repayment subject to all required deliveries, coverage and payments. If several feasible arrangements repay the same total principal, use the one with the lower actual servicing charge. Equivalent arrangements with the same objective values are accepted.

## Instructions

Unlock `propose_dated_collateral`. Supply `case_id`, an `action`, and the exact action fields in `data`:

| Action | Fields | Local effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `repay` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Reduce that loan's principal and debit cash plus any first-use fee |
| `pledge` | `record_id`, `loan_id` | Assign one free eligible asset to a loan |
| `release` | `record_id` | Remove a pledge after a coverage check; execute an attached delivery order |
| `pay_bill` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Debit cash and add the payment to the identified invoice |

Each instruction requires a corresponding customer portal approval. The tools record requested amounts; the servicing team must reconcile the customer's complete business requirements. The institutional correspondence is available through the standard service inquiry procedure.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_dated_collateral`

Prepare a repayment, collateral pledge or release, or a supplier payment under the dated collateral contract. Read the product terms and actual custody status.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
